proof.accepted_proof_definition: An atom_results entry with proof_state ENGINE_PROOF_ACCEPTED, a matching atom_routes route of AUTO_SUPPORTED or AUTO_CONTRADICTED, and a non-null proof object. This is the authoritative final auto route for that atom; compound aggregation may still make the case-level product_action REVIEW_REQUIRED or PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED.
proof.structural_validity: Accepted proof object is a registered concrete runtime proof type mapped to SUPPORT, CONTRADICTION, or DETERMINISTIC_COMPARATOR; span proofs have a non-empty source_span present verbatim in public case source, and comparator proofs use a registered frozen comparator rule.
proof.groundedness: Every proof source_span, premise, quote, and span id must be present in the authorized public evidence packet; no out-of-packet premise is allowed.
proof.semantic_soundness: At atom granularity, the accepted auto polarity must be allowed by the sealed expected proof-safe target for that atom, independent of structural validity and groundedness.
proof.proof_safe_auto: At case granularity, AUTO_SUPPORTED requires expected proof-safe SUPPORTED and AUTO_CONTRADICTED requires expected proof-safe CONTRADICTED; REVIEW_REQUIRED, INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, and the opposite polarity are unsound autos.
proof.auto_precision: Auto correctness is M4 proof-safe polarity agreement, separately by auto polarity and combined; structural validity never substitutes for correctness.

review_abstain.necessary_review: Expected product_action exactly REVIEW_REQUIRED; predicted product_action REVIEW_REQUIRED is a true positive.
review_abstain.unnecessary_review: Numerator is predicted REVIEW_REQUIRED with expected product_action not REVIEW_REQUIRED; denominator is all predicted REVIEW_REQUIRED.
review_abstain.abstain_recall: Predicted ABSTAIN_INSUFFICIENT among expected product_action ABSTAIN_INSUFFICIENT; denominator is all expected abstain cases.
review_abstain.macro_f1_auto_treatment: All 159 cases remain in the binary one-vs-rest counts; AUTO_* and PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED are negative for both classes.
review_abstain.zero_denominator: Undefined class precision, recall, or F1 is 0.

compound.membership_source: Public generalization-cases.json compound=true metadata; not prediction fields.
compound.alignment: Exact compatible atom_id within case first; then deterministic normalized text fallback using Unicode NFKC, casefold, trim, and collapsed whitespace. No fuzzy matching.
compound.missing_atoms: Each missing expected atom is incorrect.
compound.extra_atoms: Each extra predicted atom is a decomposition error and cannot be correct.
compound.denominator_rule: All compound atom metrics use 119 expected canonical atoms; case-level atom-count exact and product metrics use 52 compound cases.

subgroups.membership_source: Preregistered public/sealed holdout metadata; frozen before key and never selected from prediction errors.
subgroups.other_subgroups: Use only preregistered public/sealed metadata membership; no post-hoc subgroup creation.

statistics.authoritative_values: Raw integer counts and exact fractions
statistics.display_rounding: Percentages and Wilson bounds to 2 decimals; gate comparisons use exact fractions.

readiness.fail: At least one preregistered hard gate fails.
